translation:
It is averse to Ampelopsis [白蘞], and fears Poria with mulberry root [牡蒙], Sanguisorba [地榆], realgar [雄黃], Gentiana macrophylla [秦艽] and turtle shell [龜甲].)

Original text of the Shennong Bencao Jing [本經]: Poria [茯苓], flavor sweet, neutral. It mainly treats counterflow qi of the chest and flanks, worry, anger, fright, evil and palpitations, binding pain below the heart, cold and heat, vexation and fullness, cough and counterflow, dry mouth and parched tongue, and frees the small [intestine]
